title: Growing New Industries that Promise Economic and Non-economic Benefits
what_it_is: Growing New Industries that Promise Economic and Non-economic Benefits

sections.label: Agriculture Productivity Fund disbursement
sections.summary: The $63-million Agriculture Productivity Fund launched in end-2014 replaced the Food Fund Scheme, but only $0.69 million was disbursed, shared among 20 farms owned by 17 companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: To this end, the Government announced the launch of a $63-million Agriculture Productivity Fund (APF) in end-2014 that replaced the Food Fund Scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: However, only $0.69 million of the $63 million has been disbursed in the year since the launch of the APF.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: According to a Government statement in October 2015, this $0.69 million, or less, had been shared among 20 local farms owned by 17 companies.

sections.label: Solar panel cost decline
sections.summary: Solar panel costs fell fivefold in six years and are expected to halve in the next 20 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The cost of solar panels has come down by a factor of five in the past six years and is expected to halve in the next 20 years.

sections.label: HDB SolarNova consolidated tender
sections.summary: In June 2015 HDB called the first consolidated tender under SolarNova for 220 megawatt peak, a fraction of Singapore's estimated six megawatt peak potential.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In June 2015, HDB called the first consolidated tender under the SolarNova programme for 220 megawatt peak, which is a small fraction of the estimated six megawatt peak of solar capacity that is potentially available, according to estimates in Singapore.

sections.label: SERIS solar PV electricity mix study
sections.summary: A SERIS study suggested solar PV could contribute 20% to the electricity mix by 2050, or 30% under an accelerated scenario.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: A recent study by the Solar Energy Research Institute of Singapore (SERIS) suggested that solar PV could contribute as much as 20% to the overall electricity mix by 2050 but that figure could be pushed to 30% under an accelerated scenario.

sections.label: Manufacturing share of economy
sections.summary: Last year manufacturing accounted for 20% of the economy and employed more than 500,000 workers.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Last year, manufacturing accounted for 20% of our economy and employed more than 500,000 workers.

sections.label: RIE2020 Advanced Manufacturing funding
sections.summary: $3.3 billion has been set aside for the Advanced Manufacturing and Engineering domain under RIE2020.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: To this end, $3.3 billion has been set aside for the Advanced Manufacturing and Engineering domain under RIE2020.

sections.label: Water industry growth in Singapore
sections.summary: Self-reliance in water treatment technologies has spurred a water industry with about 180 companies and 26 private research centres in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Our motivation to be self-reliant and develop water treatment technologies, such as desalination and water reclamation, has spurred the development of a vibrant water industry.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: There are now about 180 water companies and 26 private research centres in Singapore.

sections.label: SolarNova government solar programme
sections.summary: SolarNova is a Government-led programme spearheaded by the EDB that encourages Government agencies to harness solar energy for their electricity needs.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: For example, SolarNova is a Government-led programme, spearheaded by the EDB, which encourages Government agencies to come together to harness solar energy for their electricity needs.

sections.label: MOU to build workforce capability
sections.summary: ARTC, IHPC, COLE, SC3DP, NYP and WDA signed an MOU to build workforce capability and skills through masterclasses, workshops and conferences.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Four of its key players, the Advanced Remanufacturing and Technology Centre (ARTC), Institute of High Performance Computing (IHPC), the Centre of Optical and Laser Engineering (COLE) and the Singapore Centre for 3D Printing (SC3DP), together with Nanyang Polytechnic (NYP) and WDA, have signed an MOU to build the industry's workforce capability and skills through a series of masterclasses, workshops and conferences.

sections.label: Sectoral Manpower Plans and CFE review
sections.summary: Sectoral Tripartite Committees map out Sectoral Manpower Plans, and the Committee on the Future Economy is reviewing opportunities and identifying new sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: Sectoral Tripartite Committees, comprising employers, unions and sectoral champion agencies, work together to map out Sectoral Manpower Plans (SMPs) covering skills-based career progression pathways, job re-design, as well as efforts to improve the attraction and retention of local workers as these industries evolve.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: These SMPs will help to improve productivity and develop a strong Singaporean Core within our domestic sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: I shared over the last 10 minutes how MTI has been working with the relevant agencies to catalyse sophisticated demand in all these areas.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: The opportunities presented by new and emerging industries are also on the agenda of review by the Committee on the Future Economy (CFE).

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling)
sentences.text: In today's dynamic and changing environment, it is crucial that we constantly renew and revitalise our economy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The CFE is spearheading a national effort to identify new sectors and it will recommend strategies to position Singapore ahead.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The Committee is consulting widely and seeking ideas and proposals from a range of stakeholders including the industry, academics, associations and chambers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: On the drawing board will be critical success factors to forge new pathways for a better Singapore.
